subject: Spark server problem? No lattice library?

messages.author: c5790e857463cacd
messages.subject: Spark server problem? No lattice library?
parts:
Hello,
 I have an app on spark.rstudio.com  here:

http://spark.rstudio.com/johnpaul/Water/

It has suddenly stopped working with this error message:
Error in library(lattice) : there is no package called ‘lattice’ Calls: runApp ... eval -> source -> withVisible -> eval -> eval -> library Execution halted

The app. has worked fine for many months, and I have not updated the code for months..

Any idea what the issue is?

I know that spark is going away and I am working on moving the app - but this is an odd error.

JP

messages.author: c5790e857463cacd
messages.subject: Re: Spark server problem? No lattice library?
parts:
Greg L,

Thanks for the suggestion, but lattice  comes standard as part of  R, so you should generally not need to install it. More to the point, the app was working a couple  of days ago and has not been changed since then, so it was getting the lattice package recently.
